title: Streets of Woe
author: NOVA-16
description: A Streets of Rage style beat 'em up for one or two players: three stages, a boss at the end of each, thugs of five kinds (a Slasher with a knife, a Chucker who throws bottles, a Lasher with a whip, a Fire-breather, a heavy Brute), three-hit combos with an uppercut, grabs, throws, specials, weapons and crates. Drawn fighters streamed from the cart's ROM.
